description: Zones potentiellement exposées aux glissements de terrain is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Sherbrooke - Données géomatiques. Délimitation des zones potentiellement exposées aux glissements de terrain et des bandes de protection. Attributs: ID - Identifiant unique TYPE - Type d'entité. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Sherbrooke - Données géomatiques. Its tags are Environnement, Municipal, Sherbrooke, Sécurité civile, Urbanisme. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, ESRIREST, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
